claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings (multilingual-e5 center_projected) are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for three non-jurist-preference views at characterized minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage — 21yr/137k, AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74 (v1.1+ READY); (2) Section Cross-Lingual — 1K sample, Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAIL (BLOCKED v1.1+ pending section extraction); (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — 19yr/122k, w=0.3-0.4 PASS adversarial, JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79 (EXPLORATORY v1.1+). Dense embeddings REJECTED as PRIMARY for jurist navigation (true OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 target). Two-mode tradeoff FUNDAMENTAL: no single representation dominates JP + LangDom + CiteIndep at any scale.
evidence_summary: Citation heritage: 3 scales (21yr/137k AUC 0.8455/0.8182, 22yr/144k AUC 0.7946/0.7922, 24yr/158k AUC 0.7696/0.7667) all PASS >0.75 on center_projected; dense superior to TF-IDF citation baseline. Section cross-lingual: 1K sample, Sachverhalt 0.282 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094 FAIL — hierarchy Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen confirmed. Linear hybrids: 19yr & 22yr PASS adversarial at w=0.3-0.4, but JP remains below TF-IDF baseline. Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at 8 scales (3yr-165k). True OOS ceiling verified via v8 holdout (~0.53 < 0.7). TF-IDF 174k primary modes operational (cited_decisions_tfidf JP=0.714, hybrid_0.5 JP=0.735). Data blockers: bge_/bger_ ID mapping, 2024-2026 parquet (15.5k decisions), 174k section extraction. Scale characterization identically reproduced on 12,570 ACCEPTED embeddings (2000-2002). Test suites: 22/23 substantive assertions PASS; 1 non-substantive path error in test harness.
